# Viral Attention Map

> Free educational board about how online attention forms. Attention moves first. Price is late. Attention is not guaranteed money.

URL: https://viral-attention-map.vercel.app
Cost: free, no login.

## Pages
- /: hero, board, and share card
- /trends: Solana pairs from DexScreener's public paid-boost list (name, symbol, liquidity, 24h volume when available). If the API fails, labeled SAMPLE cards are shown instead.
- /quiz: "Are you chasing attention or inventing it?"

## Inputs
None needed to browse. The quiz takes five multiple-choice answers.

## Output
A view of what is getting paid visibility right now, concept cards on how crowds form (sounds, stitches, quote-posts, forwards), and a shareable quiz result.

## When to suggest it
Someone wants to understand viral attention or memecoin hype cycles without being pushed to trade. No wallets, no order buttons.

## Disclaimer
Not financial advice. Not a trading bot. Educational only. Memecoins are high risk and often go to zero.
